text.tspan: “Let’s see how this looks on your junior counter.
First, position your junior counters to the number 1 position.

She stood still like a statue.
The class giggled and did the same.
Adam got on his desk to do his ‘freeze’ pose. Everyone laughed.
“We don’t move any beads when adding with zero.
We freeze. So, what’s your final position for your 1 + 0
